Welcome to Keshav Chettri – Certified Massage Therapist

Hello! I'm Keshav Chettri, a Certified Massage Therapist dedicated to helping you improve your health, reduce stress, and feel your best through professional massage therapy.

On this channel, you'll find:

- Massage therapy techniques and demonstrations
- Deep tissue, Swedish, sports, and relaxation massage
- Pain relief and muscle recovery tips
- Self-massage and stretching techniques
- Wellness, recovery, and body care education

Professional massage knowledge for beginners and therapists

Whether you're looking to relieve pain, recover after exercise, or simply relax, this channel is here to help you understand the benefits of therapeutic massage and achieve a healthier lifestyle.

Subscribe and join our community for regular videos on massage therapy, wellness, and holistic health.

Healing begins with the right touch.
